metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based streams of Highbiza's webshop platform: launch, find-and-order, reorder, ERP sync, marketplaces, after-sales, content, managed operations and performance.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each step names the bricks it depends on; personas are linked through customers.json JTBD steps.

rootGroups.name: Merchant Journeys
rootGroups.description: How trading companies adopt, run and grow their shop.

streams.name: Launch or Replatform a Webshop
streams.description: From a merchant's intake to a live shop: package choice, building-block selection, custom work, a test environment, content loading and go-live. Highbiza describes this as its seven-step way of working.
outcomes: Lower migration risk from Magento or WooCommerce
